data.long_meaning: The name Leesa is derived from the Greek word leos, meaning 'lion'. In biblical times, lions symbolized courage, strength, and power. The suffix -a denotes femininity. Therefore, Leesa can be interpreted as 'God's relief' or 'deliverance'. The name Leesa carries the meaning “God's relief, deliverance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leesa usually hope their child will grow to embody god's relief, deliverance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
